key_insight: The multi-domain AAA-least squares (nAAALS) method efficiently approximates harmonic functions across coupled interior and exterior domains with evolving boundaries.
engineering_relevance: It offers a low-cost computational approach for coupled-boundary problems in inviscid fluid dynamics and potentially other multi-domain engineering applications.
method: Use AAA rational approximation of boundary conjugate data to place poles according to local geometry and global domain configuration.
Enforce coupled matching conditions across boundaries through a modified least-squares formulation.
Couple nAAALS with standard Runge–Kutta schemes to evolve domain boundaries.
evidence_signal: Vortex-patch tests reproduce known equilibria and evolve new and existing non-equilibrium configurations, with reported accuracy and runtimes of seconds on a standard laptop.
watch_item: The abstract provides no quantitative error benchmarks or scaling results, so performance for more complex geometries remains to be assessed.
paper_title: Multi-domain AAA-least squares methods and applications
